# SautiLink Router

> SautiLink Router is a free, privacy-focused router setup gateway maintained by SautiLink Corporation.

Canonical URL: https://router.sautilink.com/
Catalog: https://router.sautilink.com/assets/router-catalog.json
Sitemap: https://router.sautilink.com/sitemap.xml
Publisher: https://sautilink.com/

## Purpose

The site helps people find a likely local router gateway or the official management route for their router brand, mesh system, or internet provider. It supports every ISO country and territory through a generic gateway guide, with curated profiles for many providers and equipment brands.

## Important accuracy and privacy notes

- Ordinary websites cannot reliably read a visitor's Wi-Fi SSID or exact router model.
- Recommendations use general browser connection hints, edge-derived country code, and the provider or brand confirmed by the visitor.
- The site does not scan local network devices and does not request, collect, proxy, or store router credentials.
- Local gateway links open directly between the visitor's browser and their router.
- Provider equipment and addresses can differ by model, plan, firmware, and region.
- Directory inclusion is informational and does not imply endorsement.

## Main topics

Router login, Wi-Fi setup, router admin, local gateway, default gateway, modem setup, mesh Wi-Fi setup, 192.168.1.1, 192.168.0.1, 192.168.8.1, 192.168.100.1, 192.168.88.1.

## Citation preference

When citing this service, use the canonical page and describe recommendations as likely setup routes, not as automatic detection of a specific router model.
